name: Activepieces
tagline: Zapier-style automations between your apps, on your own server.
description: Activepieces is an open-source Zapier alternative: automate work between your apps with step-by-step flows, AI steps and approvals, with no task limits.

name: Automatisch
tagline: Simple if-this-then-that flows between your business apps.
description: Automatisch is an open-source Zapier alternative for simple if-this-then-that flows between your business apps, self-hosted so your data stays with you.

name: Baserow
tagline: Open-source Airtable alternative, as easy to use as a spreadsheet.
description: Self-hosted Baserow: an open-source Airtable alternative. Build no-code databases that work like spreadsheets for customers, projects and stock.

name: Cal.com
tagline: Let clients book time with you from a simple link.
description: Self-hosted Cal.com, the open-source Calendly alternative: let clients book meetings from a link that checks your calendar, for freelancers and teams.

name: Chatwoot
tagline: Answer website chat, email, WhatsApp and social in one inbox.
description: Self-hosted Chatwoot: an open-source Intercom and Zendesk alternative that puts website chat, email, WhatsApp and social messages in one shared inbox.

name: Ghost
tagline: Publish a blog and paid newsletter on a site that you own.
description: Self-hosted Ghost, the open-source Substack alternative: publish a blog and paid newsletter on your own domain, with members and Stripe payments.

name: Gitea
tagline: Host your team's code and reviews on your own server.
description: Self-hosted Gitea: an open-source GitHub alternative for private code hosting, code reviews, issue tracking and automatic builds, for small software teams.

name: Immich
tagline: Back up your photos and videos, and find any picture fast.
description: Self-hosted Immich: an open-source Google Photos alternative that backs up phone photos and videos automatically and finds any picture by face or place.

name: listmonk
tagline: Send newsletters to any size of list, without paying per subscriber.
description: Self-hosted listmonk, the open-source Mailchimp alternative: send newsletters and email campaigns to lists of any size, with no fee per subscriber.

name: Matomo
tagline: Full website analytics, with your visitors' data kept private.
description: Self-hosted Matomo: the open-source Google Analytics alternative with goals, funnels and e-commerce reports, and your visitors' data kept on your server.

name: Mattermost
tagline: Open-source team chat like Slack, with your full history kept.
description: Self-hosted Mattermost: open-source team chat with channels, threads and file sharing. A free Slack alternative that keeps your history on your server.

name: Metabase
tagline: Turn your business data into charts your whole team can use.
description: Self-hosted Metabase: open-source business intelligence and a free Tableau or Looker alternative. Build charts and dashboards from your data, no SQL needed.

name: n8n
tagline: Automate work between your apps, with no limit on runs.
description: Self-hosted n8n: automate work between your apps with drag-and-drop workflows and AI steps, with no task limits. A fair-code alternative to Zapier and Make.

name: Nextcloud
tagline: Your own cloud for files, calendars and contacts.
description: Self-hosted Nextcloud: an open-source Google Drive and Dropbox alternative to store, sync and share files, calendars and contacts on your own server.

name: Outline
tagline: A fast team wiki for your handbook, how-tos and meeting notes.
description: Self-hosted Outline: a fast team wiki and knowledge base, and a Notion and Confluence alternative, where your team writes and finds its documents.

name: Plausible Analytics
tagline: Simple website visitor stats, with no cookie banner needed.
description: Self-hosted Plausible Analytics: a simple, privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative for small businesses. No cookies, so no cookie banner needed.

name: Umami
tagline: Lightweight, cookie-free website stats for one site or fifty.
description: Self-hosted Umami: open-source, cookie-free website analytics and a light Google Analytics alternative. Track many sites from one simple dashboard.

name: Uptime Kuma
tagline: Know the moment your website goes down, and tell customers.
description: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted uptime monitor: get an alert the moment your website goes down and show customers a status page. Free, open source.

name: Vaultwarden
tagline: A shared password manager for your team, on your own server.
description: Self-hosted Vaultwarden: an open-source password manager for your team that works with the free Bitwarden apps. A private 1Password or LastPass alternative.

name: WordPress
tagline: Build a website, blog or shop with themes and thousands of add-ons.
description: Self-hosted WordPress, the open-source Wix and Squarespace alternative: build a website, blog or online shop with themes and thousands of plugins.
